messages.author: 32bf4f27a31a68db
messages.subject: Strange crash
parts:
Hello,

I'm running a fairly simple model with T family and a single random effect.

After about an hour of running, it always crashes with the following error:

    GitID: file: error-handler.c  bef19e1b3915514bedbe5c65d523afb6a0064b1b - Fri Oct 7 13:55:23 2022 +0300
    Error:21 Reason: This should not happen
    Message: Condition `density->Pinv' is not TRUE
    Line:925 Function: GMRFLib_density_Pinv

Some environmental details:
INLA_22.10.07
R version 4.2.1 (2022-06-23)
aarch64-apple-darwin20

Any suggestions on how to diagnose and fix this?

Thank You!!!!

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Strange crash
parts:
there is noting simple with family="t" ....

try adding

inla(...,
inla.mode="experimental",
control.inla=list(cmin=0))

unless your dof is very low, this is ok
